No screenshot, diagnostic archive, current-version retest, or follow-up exists.
Always On Top skips excluded/game windows and SetWindowPos can fail across integrity or special full-screen window boundaries.
inferences: VirtualBox elevation, full-screen/seamless mode, game-mode detection, or target HWND replacement could each explain both missing border and failed pin.

comment.body:
Thanks for identifying VirtualBox 7.0.8 and the missing Always On Top border. The original PowerToys 0.70.1 report does not say which VirtualBox display mode or integrity boundary is active, and those select different Windows paths.

**Needed**
1. Please reproduce on the latest stable PowerToys build and submit a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately after the failed pin attempt.
2. Please state whether VirtualBox is windowed, full-screen, or seamless, and whether both VirtualBox.exe and PowerToys are elevated; if possible, repeat once with both non-elevated.

This will distinguish an exclusion/game-mode decision from a SetWindowPos or target-window replacement failure.

proposed_fixes.title: Pin the stable VirtualBox top-level window across display modes
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Best current hypothesis: the foreground HWND is excluded/replaced during VirtualBox full-screen or seamless transitions, or SetWindowPos is denied across an integrity boundary.
plan: Log target HWND, process, mode-relevant styles, exclusion/game detection, integrity level, and SetWindowPos result.
Resolve the stable owner/top-level VirtualBox window before tracking and update tracking if the app replaces it.
Respect Windows integrity and full-screen restrictions, with clear user feedback when pinning is not permitted.
verification: Test VirtualBox windowed, full-screen, and seamless modes with matched and mismatched elevation and verify supported modes pin or report a precise limitation.

confidence.rationale: The missing border narrows the stage but not whether the cause is exclusion, HWND replacement, or integrity.
